open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  have append_mono {α} {a b c d : List α}
      (ha : a ⊆ c) (hb : b ⊆ d) : (a ++ b) ⊆ (c ++ d) :=
    List.append_subset.mpr ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left d ha,
      List.subset_append_of_subset_right c hb⟩
  induction h with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar => simp only [extractOldExprVars, List.Subset.empty]
  | abs hn ih => assumption
  | quant htr he ihtr ihe => exact append_mono ihtr ihe
  | app hfn he valid ihfn ihe =>
      unfold extractOldExprVars
      split
      · simp only [List.Subset, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
    Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.nil_append, imp_self, implies_true]
      · next Hfalse =>
        exfalso
        cases valid (by constructor)
        simp_all only [List.append_subset, List.subset_append_of_subset_left, List.subset_append_of_subset_right,
    and_self, implies_true, Lambda.LExpr.fvar.injEq, imp_false, not_and, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂,
    forall_apply_eq_imp_iff, forall_eq']
      · exact append_mono ihfn ihe
  | ite hc ht he ihc iht ihe => exact append_mono (append_mono ihc iht) ihe
  | eq h1 h2 ih1 ih2 => exact append_mono ih1 ih2

edits.replacement:
simp only [List.Subset, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
    Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.nil_append, imp_self, implies_true]

simp_all only [List.append_subset, List.subset_append_of_subset_left, List.subset_append_of_subset_right,
    and_self, implies_true, Lambda.LExpr.fvar.injEq, imp_false, not_and, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂,
    forall_apply_eq_imp_iff, forall_eq']
